_formato: Transport data of the heavy species, read by the simulator (prototipo/modelo.py) or given by --transport.
Each transported species except E needs massa_u, the mass in u. The background gas is transported only with --free-gas.

Positive ions of charge 1 need mobilidade, reduced to the Loschmidt density in cm2/(V s), of tipo constante (K0), frost (K0 and EN_aquecimento in Td, with K = K0 (1 + (E/N)/EN_aquecimento)^(-1/2)) or tabela (E_N in Td, increasing, and K0, interpolated linearly; below the first point, clamped; above the last, clamped or, with acima = raiz, K = K_last (E/N_last / (E/N))^(1/2)).

Neutrals need difusao, D = (D0/p) (T/T0)^expoente in m2/s with p in atm, and perda_na_parede, the probability gamma of loss per collision with the wall (flux gamma/(2 - gamma) n v/2; the free background gas does not need it).
With --free-gas, the species need atomos_do_fundo, the atoms of the background gas that the wall returns per absorbed particle.
The fonte fields are only a record of the source.

N.fonte: estimated diffusion: measured self-diffusion of N2 (0.202 cm2/s, 1 atm, 300 K) scaled by the reduced mass and by the hard-sphere diameter of N (2.75 Å at 280 K, Diffusion coefficients of O and N atoms in inert gases) against 3.75 Å for N2; loss: recombination at the quartz wall, gamma = 2.16e-6 (Mazánková, Trunec and Krčma, 2015, afterglow at 1000 Pa)

N2.fonte: self-diffusion taken equal to the measured one of N2(A); used only with --free-gas

N2(A).fonte: diffusion: 0.202 cm2/s at 760 Torr and 300 K (Planet. Space Sci., 1967, doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4); exponent 1.75 assumed; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N2(B).fonte: assumed equal to N2(A): short radiative lifetime, transport matters little; diffusion: 0.202 cm2/s at 760 Torr and 300 K (Planet. Space Sci., 1967, doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4); exponent 1.75 assumed; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N2(A').fonte: assumed equal to N2(A): short radiative lifetime, transport matters little; diffusion: 0.202 cm2/s at 760 Torr and 300 K (Planet. Space Sci., 1967, doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4); exponent 1.75 assumed; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N2(C).fonte: assumed equal to N2(A): short radiative lifetime, transport matters little; diffusion: 0.202 cm2/s at 760 Torr and 300 K (Planet. Space Sci., 1967, doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4); exponent 1.75 assumed; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N^+.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 204-205, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 3%; above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N2^+.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 203, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 3%; above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N3^+.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 204-205, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 7%; above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N4^+.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 204-205, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 3%; measured only up to 40 Td (N4+ dissociates above); above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)
